many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

from hermes_tools import terminal
script = r'''python3 - <<'PY'
A=['..1..','11111','1...1','11.11','.1.1.']
B=['...1...','.11111.','..111..','111.111']
C=['1..1','.11.','.11.','1..1','.11.']
D=['.11.','111.','11..','.1..']
O=['..11','.111','111.','.1..']
def crop(x, h=4,w=4):
 r=(len(x)-h)//2;c=(len(x[0])-w)//2
 return [s[c:c+w] for s in x[r:r+h]]
for name,x in [('A',A),('B',B),('C',C),('D',D)]:
 print(name, 'ones',sum(s.count('1') for s in x), 'crop',crop(x))
# centered crop, compare majority and union/intersection
xs=[crop(x) for x in [A,B,C,D]]
for mode in ['major','union','inter']:
 out=[]
 for i in range(4):
  row=''
  for j in range(4):
   n=sum(x[i][j]=='1' for x in xs)
   row += '1' if (n>=3 if mode=='major' else n>=1 if mode=='union' else n==4) else '.'
  out.append(row)
 print(mode,out)
PY'''
r=terminal(script, timeout=30)
print(r['output'])
